title: Terminals response
description: Response containing a list of terminals.

Terminal-Battery-Level.title: Terminal battery level
Terminal-Battery-Level.description: The current battery level of the terminal as a percentage (0-100).

Terminal-Id.title: Terminal ID
Terminal-Id.description: The unique identifier of the terminal.

Terminal-Last-Online-At.title: Terminal last online timestamp
Terminal-Last-Online-At.description: The date and time when the terminal was last seen online.

Terminal-Name.title: Terminal name
Terminal-Name.description: The name of the terminal device.

Terminal-Online.title: Terminal online status
Terminal-Online.description:
Indicates whether the terminal is currently online and connected.

| Value | Description |
|-------|-------------|
| `true` | Terminal is online and available |
| `false` | Terminal is offline |

Terminal-Serial-Number.title: Terminal serial number
Terminal-Serial-Number.description: The serial number of the terminal device.

Terminal-Type.title: Terminal type
Terminal-Type.description: The hardware type/model of the terminal device.
